note: Full redeploy. Every protocol contract sits behind a branded ERC1967 proxy, including the surplus buffer and stability pool, which were bare contracts in v1. The protocol token is PLG (on-chain name Pledge Finance, symbol PLG, 18 decimals) and is deliberately not upgradeable. The abandoned launchpad token at 0xDfC0a301 carries the same PLG symbol, so always match on address.

brandedProxies.why: A contract's name is bound to its bytecode, so a plain ERC1967Proxy always displays as `ERC1967Proxy` on an explorer. Each module therefore gets an empty subclass of ERC1967Proxy carrying a Pledge Finance name. They add no behavior: storage, the ERC1967 implementation slot, and upgradeToAndCall all work exactly as with a plain proxy.
brandedProxies.consequence: Branding an address is only possible at deploy time. It can never be retrofitted onto a live proxy.

verification.status: exact_match for all implementations and proxies
verification.reason: Blockscout's API on this chain sits behind Cloudflare and rejects automated requests, so forge verify-contract cannot reach it. Import into Blockscout from a browser via Verify & Publish -> Sourcify.

chainlink.note: Prices are USD with 18 decimals. 4 days of staleness tolerance because equity feeds stop updating outside market hours; a tighter bound would freeze repay and withdraw every weekend. Note that withdraw always reads the oracle, even for a debt-free position.

implementations.note: Never integrate against these. They exist only as upgrade targets behind the proxies above.

upgradeRules.pattern: UUPS behind ERC1967. Upgrade with upgradeToAndCall(newImpl, "") from the owner.
upgradeRules.storage: Append only. New variables go at the end of the leaf contract. PledgeUupsOwnable must keep `owner` alone at slot 0; there are no storage gaps anywhere.
upgradeRules.vaultImmutables: PledgeVaultManager holds usdg, usdgDecimals, and surplusBuffer as immutables, so they live in implementation bytecode rather than proxy storage. Any replacement implementation MUST be constructed with (0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168, 0xc6D477491ACE30fa5651ac61C735C2B636B095c4, address(0)) or the proxy will silently point at a different USDG or surplus buffer.

staking.onlyLivePool: Pool 2. It stakes and rewards PLG 0x1BE3010124C86e8a03c6Fb6e91c534D4A2b1fFCf. Pools 0 and 1 are retired and can never be deleted or re-pointed: `_pools` is append-only and a pool's tokens are fixed at addPool with no setter. Both are inactive and hidden by the frontend.
